name: Cubs Games (Next.js)
author: cubs-games-site
description: Pelican egg for hosting the Cubs Games Next.js application. The server clones the 2.0 branch from the configured GitHub repository on each startup, installs dependencies, builds the app, and starts Next.js.
startup: bash -lc 'set -e; cd /home/container; source=/tmp/cubs-games-source; repo="$REPOSITORY_URL"; case "$repo" in *.git) ;; *) repo="$repo.git" ;; esac; rm -rf "$source"; if [ -n "${REPOSITORY_TOKEN:-}" ]; then git -c "http.extraHeader=Authorization: Bearer ${REPOSITORY_TOKEN}" clone --depth 1 --branch 2.0 "$repo" "$source"; else git clone --depth 1 --branch 2.0 "$repo" "$source"; fi; find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name node_modules -exec rm -rf {} +; cp -a "$source/." /home/container/; if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi; npm run build; exec npm run start -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port {{SERVER_PORT}}'

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
source=/tmp/cubs-games-source
repo="$REPOSITORY_URL"
case "$repo" in
  *.git) ;;
  *) repo="$repo.git" ;;
esac
rm -rf "$source"
if [ -n "${REPOSITORY_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  git -c "http.extraHeader=Authorization: Bearer ${REPOSITORY_TOKEN}" clone --depth 1 --branch 2.0 "$repo" "$source"
else
  git clone --depth 1 --branch 2.0 "$repo" "$source"
fi
find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name node_modules -exec rm -rf {} +
cp -a "$source/." /mnt/server/
npm ci
npm run build
echo 'Cubs Games installation complete.'

variables.name: Repository URL
variables.description: GitHub repository URL without a trailing slash. The 2.0 branch will be downloaded.

variables.name: Repository Token
variables.description: Optional GitHub personal access token for a private repository. The token needs repository read access.
